en.title: Scorekeeper 5-Character Code Login and Lane Assignment
en.excerpt: Detailed operational guide for line scorekeepers logging in via 5-character short codes and managing assigned target lane scoring on mobile devices.
en.content:
Frictionless Scorekeeper Access

To avoid requiring field volunteers and referees to register personal accounts, Archeris uses lightweight 5-character access codes (e.g., SK-78A). Scorekeepers simply visit the portal and enter the code to begin scoring immediately.

Generating Access Codes

Organizers generate codes under Event Dashboard > Scorekeepers:

  1. Click + Generate Scorekeeper Codes.
  2. Assign each code to specific target butts (e.g., Target 1-4) or leave flexible for multi-butt rotation.
  3. Print or share code slips with field officials during the morning technical briefing.

Entering the Scorekeeper Portal

Scorekeepers open archeris.net/scorekeeper/login on their smartphone or tablet browser and type their 5-character code. No password or email is required.

Selecting Assigned Target Lanes

Once authenticated, the scorekeeper selects their active target butt (e.g., Target 3) and wave session. Archer names and shooting positions (A, B, C, D) are loaded instantly for quick-tap score entry.
